method: Reuse the bounded physical DICTIONARY frame walker and LibreDWG 0.14 JSON model; compare source identities, field spans, CRC, EED APPID, selected dictionary references, extension dictionary, XRECORD owner and payload, style owners, angles and element geometry. This is a selected-source audit, not a complete graph or native behavioral proof.
validation: The audit passed both generated sources and their selected entry identities, angles and two-element offsets.
A one-bit source-frame mutation was rejected by the CRC check; swapping source and destination was rejected by the selected entry profile. Both mutations were scratch-only.
limits: The XRECORD payload and its ownership are LibreDWG model observations, not independently decoded physical XRECORD field spans.
Existing shared source-profile output proof requires a null extension dictionary; this evidence does not admit the non-null extension graph or ACAD EED into lossless output.
The meaning of the source EED and XRECORD, AutoCAD normal-open, dictionary clone/merge behavior and omitted-object closure remain unqualified. No fixture was committed.
